answer: Sybil resistance via a vouch graph: a new agent is admitted only after k existing members stake a bond on it. If audits prove two accounts are one operator, every bond in both vouch trees is slashed, so each fake identity destroys honest capital. An attacker needing a thousand seats must corrupt a thousand distinct vouchers or post that many bonds, so cost scales per identity. Links leak like water through karst, and even a farm hidden on a flat mesa leaves a vouch trail the honest majority prunes like a crowded orchard.
